scope: Independent visual comparison of the supplied full official-product motif, native RGBA candidate and supplied gray-background alpha composite; read-only technical alpha/component analysis. No image was edited.

sourceQualification.attributionVerificationScope: The supplied source image was visually inspected. Product-page provenance/artist attribution is inherited from the parent research, not independently reverified on the web by this reviewer.
sourceQualification.incarnationLimit: The approved subject is the stylized motif printed on the official product. It is not an asserted episode model sheet or exact canonical geometry.

observations: The huge asymmetric pale ears, pink tufts, hooked pale muzzle, red eyes with dark heart pupils and white lattice highlights identify the same source subject.
The spotted red bow tie, pale forelimbs, lime cart with pink heart panel, near black-rimmed wheel with white heart and partially overlapped far wheel correspond to the supplied product motif.
The foreground/background wheel overlap and attached mobility cart read as one complete supporting character. The submitted canvas contains one subject, not a sheet or several poses.

The pink perimeter line belongs to the stylized source treatment. Candidate outline geometry, color strength and tiny highlights differ from the photographed printed source; no pixel or geometric identity claim is made.

alphaAndFrame.interpretation: At alpha >=16 there is exactly one connected component, completely inside the canvas, with no significant border pixel. The tiny bottom-border trace is very low-alpha native residue, not a cut-off wheel or limb. RGB glow displayed by a raw preview is not an opaque background; the supplied actual alpha composite shows the clean silhouette. Some low-alpha native residue exists, so not every pixel outside the strong silhouette is exactly alpha zero.

limits: Merchandise stylization is retained, including the pink outline; this is not a certified episode-design reproduction.
Margins are narrow on the left, top and especially bottom (9 px at alpha >=16), despite the generation prompt asking for generous margins. Important silhouette parts remain inside the frame.
Maximum alpha is 254 rather than 255. Keep the native transparency; this review does not authorize or perform thresholding, recoloring or background repair.
Very low-alpha specks remain in transparent margins and on 32 sampled border pixels; the strongest edge alpha is recorded above. No detached visible component exists at alpha >=16.
This acceptance covers an autonomous static support drawing. It adds no selectable combat kit, movement animation or in-game placement verification.
